description:
Mandatory Skills:
 5+ years' experience developing web based application software using .
 Net/technologies. Experience with Microsoft C# is required.
 Experience with HTML/ASP.Net development is required.
 Experience using JavaScript is required.
 Experience with IIS is required.
 Experience with XML is required.
 Experience with Microsoft SQL Server 2005/2008 is required.
 Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment.
 Self-motivated, independent person with ability to work with little direction, not hesitant to ask questions or suggest improvements.
 Able to manage multiple and changing priorities.
 Experience in SDLC including construction, testing and support.
 
 Desired Skills:
 Experience with Responsive Web design
 Experience with Oracle is a plus.
 Experience with ASP.Net MVC is a plus.
 Experience with AJAX a strong plus.
 Experience with Query a strong plus.
 Experience with Web Service a plus.
 Experience developing mobile apps a plus
 Experience using with unit testing tools such as Microsoft Unit Testing or Unit is a strong plus
 Experience using a mock library such as MOQ or Rhino Mock is a plus.
 Experience following a Continuous Integration process (CruiseControl.Net) is a plus
 BS or BA degree preferred
